text:
Maya: Short thread to capture owners for the KV-cache OOM follow-up. Focus: profiling, GC knobs, canary gates, and recurring pattern detection.

Dan: I can lead the remediation sprint coordination and keep the action board updated.

Aj: I'll run heap snapshots + live tracer on staging and produce a short analysis note. Plan to replay the incident at low rate, capture 20m traces.

Sara: I'll implement a soft cap and improved eviction logging. Proposal: `kv.soft_limit_pct=70`, `kv.eviction_batch=25` for the trial window.

Leo: I'll own the canary rollout and dashboarding. Canary gates: block ramp if OOM_count>0 or avg_gc_pause>250ms.

Priya: I'll add a rolling anomaly detector that flags shards with repeated growth spikes. If same shard fires 3x in 7d -> auto-create an ops ticket.

Aj: Staging commands:
```
# reserve pool
./infra/reserve_pool --name staging-kv --hours 3 --start 1767780000
# replay incident at 0.5x
./tools/replay --since 2026-03-18T02:00Z --dur 2h --rate 0.5 --tag replay_profiling
# profiler
./kv-profiler --out /tmp/kv_trace.pb --time 20m --sample 1/100
```

OpsBot: reserved staging-kv from 1767780000 to 17677810800. Owner: infra-team. :white_check_mark:

Maya: Owners & due dates: Aj (profiling) +2bd, Sara (soft cap & logs) +3bd, Leo (canary + dashboards) +4bd, Priya (anomaly job + backfill) +7bd. Dan to keep the board updated weekly.

Dan: I'll create the sprint card and weekly rubric. Weekly check-in Fridays 10am PT until we see 30d stability.

Aj: Upload plan: profiles to gs://redwood-dev/kv-profiles/1767778000/ with README explaining flags and replay tag. I will annotate hotspots in the README.

Sara: I'll open a small PR with knobs + eviction histograms and add a short test asserting eviction metrics increase under forced pressure. Will mark for fast review.

Leo: Dashboard panels: `kv.resident_bytes`, `kv.evicted_total`, `kv.frag_ratio`, `kv.gc_pause_ms`. I'll add 5m median smoothing to the frag_ratio panels.

Priya: Anomaly rule: if rate(kv.resident_bytes[1h]) > baseline + 3*sigma OR frag_ratio jumps >0.15 in 1h then tag. We'll backfill 90d to look for recurring shards.

Maya: Risks: profiling may increase latency - ensure `--isolate` on replay and exclude critical tenants from staging run. Also compaction may be needed if fragmentation stays high after GC tuning.

Aj: I'll pass `--isolate=true` and flag traces so dashboards can filter them out.

Sara: Draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/kv-service/pulls/4971 (soft cap + eviction logs + compaction TODO).

Leo: Canary plan: ramp 5% -> 25% -> 50% over 8h windows, stop and rollback on any OOM or >200ms median increase in p95 latency.

Dan: Action matrix: Aj: run profiler & upload; Sara: PR & tests; Leo: dashboards + canary plan; Priya: anomaly job + backfill; Dan: create sprint and weekly rubric.

Maya: Post one-line status in this thread by EOD tomorrow. Ping me for unblockers.

Aj: status: profiler queued, will run once pool is available.

Sara: status: PR drafted, unit tests passing locally.

Leo: status: dashboard template created; will link when Aj uploads metrics.

Priya: status: detector config drafted, starting backfill tonight.

Dan: status: sprint card created and assigned.

Maya: Note - if frag_ratio remains >0.5 after tuning, add compaction to the sprint and schedule a maintenance window.

Sara: adding compaction playbook to the PR description as a TODO.

Aj: filing a CI ticket to include a small memory-growth smoke test to catch regressions early.

Maya: Thanks. Closing thread; will post weekly rollup on Friday.

Priya: End.
